newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Saturday called for strengthening the process of regional cooperation within the framework of SAARC.
Policy to give autonomy to state-run radio and television will be formulated in next three months.
Prime Minister H D Deve Gowda of India will visit Bangladesh January 5-6 at the invitation of his counterpart Sheikh Hasina, officials sources said in Dhaka.
The government is likely to announce a package of measures for improving the condition in jails, Home Ministry sources said.

Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed, now visiting Calcutta, discussed with the West Bengal chief minister Jyoti Basu the possibility of introducing direct bus service between Calcutta and Dhaka by February.
More than 100 inmates of an orphanage at a village in Chandpur district were injured when outsiders attacked them on Saturday.
Dhaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DCCI) said bureaucratic bottlenecks were blocking the way for any significant response from foreign investors to Bangladesh's lucratic incentives.
Executive Dorector of United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) Nafis Sadik arrived in Dhaka on Saturday on a four-day official visit to Bangladesh.
